## FAQs

You have questions, we have resources and answers.

Who can purchase LP Portfolio Analytics?

LP Portfolio Analytics is suitable for any limited partner with a portfolio of alternative assets.

Who is LP Portfolio Analytics built for?

Any LP looking for a powerful data management tool that helps them spend less time collecting investment data and make better, data-driven decisions.

What asset classes does LP Portfolio Analytics support?

LP Portfolio Analytics provides comprehensive support for LPs investing across the alternative asset class spectrum, including Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Estate, and Infrastructure.

Where can I access a demo of LP Portfolio Analytics?

Sign up for a demo of LP Portfolio Analytics at [carta.com/demo/lp-portfolio-analytics/](https://carta.com/demo/lp-portfolio-analytics/).
